technique_name: Generate a blog post with the headline "What Is Cloud Computing?"
description: Cloud computing is an internet-based computing model that enables the delivery of applications, platforms and services over the internet. It provides users with on-demand access to resources such as computing power, storage and applications, so they can more easily create and access data from virtually any location.
